traditions.KJV: and to which of the saints wilt thou turn ?

traditions.KJV: For wrath killeth the foolish man ,

traditions.KJV: His children are far from safety ,

traditions.KJV: and they are crushed in the gate ,

traditions.KJV: neither [ is there ] any to deliver [ them ] .

traditions.KJV: Whose harvest the hungry eateth up ,

traditions.KJV: and taketh it even out of the thorns ,

traditions.KJV: and the robber swalloweth up their substance .

traditions.KJV: neither doth trouble spring out of the ground ;

traditions.KJV: Which doeth great things and unsearchable ;

traditions.KJV: marvellous things without number :

traditions.KJV: and sendeth waters upon the fields :

traditions.KJV: To set up on high those that be low ;

traditions.LXX: ἀπολωλότας ἐξεγείροντα ·
traditions.KJV: that those which mourn may be exalted to safety .

traditions.LXX: διαλλάσσοντα βουλὰς πανούργων ,

traditions.KJV: He taketh the wise in their own craftiness :

traditions.KJV: and the counsel of the froward is carried headlong .

traditions.KJV: They meet with darkness in the daytime ,

traditions.KJV: But he saveth the poor from the sword , from their mouth ,

traditions.KJV: and from the hand of the mighty .

traditions.KJV: Behold , happy [ is ] the man whom God correcteth :

traditions.KJV: therefore despise not thou the chastening of the Almighty :

traditions.KJV: For he maketh sore , and bindeth up :

traditions.KJV: he woundeth , and his hands make whole .

traditions.KJV: In famine he shall redeem thee from death :
